about: Check scripts that open their own browser page without the WebGL2-layer shim, so a MARGO_COMPAT=1 run of them is native WebGPU (KB-SKY-COMPATCHECK1). Each is owed compatShim from scripts/support/compat-shim.js, or a line "MARGO_COMPAT not applicable: <reason>". tests/gpu-compat-honoured.test.js keeps this list exact.
